required_facts_checked: The viewer followed ChatGPT search failing to find an earlier course conversation and ineffective manual scrolling and keyword searches.
The export download was 775 MB and its incomplete ZIP was unreadable by Windows, even after two downloads.
Claude Code extracted important content including conversations.json at about 155 MB and chat.html at about 160 MB.
The initial interface idea was a GitHub-style contribution graph with date-based conversation details.
Claude helped with the UI mockup and API response formats, while the planned architecture used FastAPI with Vite and vanilla JavaScript.
The workflow used no tests or TDD, and Claude managed implementation without the writer examining the code.
The first stable version took one or two iterations and about two to three hours.
The backend used FastAPI, the frontend used Vite-bundled vanilla JavaScript, minsearch powered search and one FastAPI server served the frontend.
The archive contained 2,808 conversations and 45,247 messages spanning 2022-12-21 to 2026-02-06.
The first search found the course conversation, and caching was added after initial indexing took time.
unsupported_claims_removed: Removed claims about test coverage, robustness or production readiness that the source did not establish.
Removed causal explanations for the corrupted ZIP and search failure that were not documented.
substantive_edits: Rewrote the article as a reader-facing explanation of input, interface planning, implementation, architecture and search results.
Kept the human and Claude Code actions distinct, including the explicit absence of tests and code inspection.
Preserved archive sizes, iteration count, time estimate, message totals and date range.
